comments.body:
Yeah, I would agree about CH over DE. Maybe it’s the smaller scale, maybe it’s the culture, idk. Regardless, things get a bit weird here sometimes, and they deal with things on a case by case basis instead of putting everyone into a “box”. While rules are rules, people are people. 

I understand your permit was renewed, but for an anecdote, the whole country is way behind on work permits lol. My wife and I have been here for 5 years and I have a solid 5 year contract moving forward. I’m months overdue for my renewal. Immigration keeps telling me it’s coming, my employer is sweating.  Polizei keep shrugging. Talk it through and don’t panic. We’re on CH.
comments.author: StuffyDuckLover
